# Concept to Action Coach

> An AI agent skill for explaining technical concepts to beginners and turning understanding into a small, verifiable action.

Maintainer: kevin-12-ou
Repository: https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/concept-to-action-coach
License: MIT
Skill name: concept-to-action-coach
Version: 1.0.0
Install: npx skills add kevin-12-ou/concept-to-action-coach --skill concept-to-action-coach
